newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND GUARANTEE THEMSELVES PLAY-OFF PLACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND GUARANTEE THEMSELVES PLAY-OFF PLACE.

text.p: England beat Poland 2-0 in a tough, uncompromising World Cup qualifier on Saturday to guarantee themselves the runners-up spot at worst from European group two. The result means Poland cannot reach the finals in France next year.
Alan Shearer scored after only five minutes, arrowing his right-footed drive just inside goalkeeper Andrzej Wozniak's far post to round off a four-man move that began deep in England's own half.
The second goal came just seconds from time when Robert Lee broke free of the Polish defence, beat Wozniak and squared to Teddy Sheringham who scored from close range.

Shearer had a chance to put the game beyond Poland's reach much earlier when he won a penalty after being obstructed by Adam Ledworn in injury time at the end of the first half. But he fired his spot-kick against the post.

The result leaves Italy top of the group with 16 points from six games followed by England who have 15 from six. Poland, with four points from five games, are eliminated along with lightweights Georgia and Moldova.
